remarks: An extensively updated home on a quiet cul-de-sac offers a serene setting, while still conveniently close to the YMCA, public schools and Town center.  Step inside this three-level residence and be greeted by an abundance of natural light streaming in through plentiful windows and French doors. The home's open and airy ambiance has a thoughtful design and layout. Four spacious bedrooms and 3.5 modern bathrooms offer ample living space for all.  The heart of the home, the award-winning gourmet kitchen combined with the adjoining family room, is an entertainer's dream come true. Fully equipped and designed with functionality in mind the perfect place to create meals with family and friends. Then retreat to the cozy living room with vaulted ceilings to enjoy a book alongside a roaring fire.  Flooded with natural light, a finished lower level provides additional space for relaxation, entertainment or exercise. This home truly has it all, including an in-ground heated pool for summer enjoyment plus a 24kW full house generator.  The impressive outdoor living space features a great stone terrace and an abundance of French doors for easy indoor-outdoor flow. The expansive backyard is level and adorned with beautiful perennial gardens, charming stone walls and mature trees that provide a sense of privacy and tranquility.  Experience the charm of New Canaan living at 34 Horton Lane, a home that combines comfort, style, and convenience.
